title: Discover Roadmap Union
description: Read-only cross-roadmap autopilot discovery union: open execution leaves across every open roadmap root, each tagged with its source roots and ranked by autopilot suitability.

mode.description: Fixed literal distinguishing this cross-roadmap union report from the single-root roadmap graph shape.

roots.description: Every open roadmap root the union enumeration started from: an issue found by the configured roadmap label, an embedded roadmap-id marker, or a configured legacy root.

number.description: Issue number of this roadmap root.

state.description: Open/closed state of this roadmap root.

roadmapMarkerId.description: This root's own embedded roadmap-id marker value, or empty when the root issue carries no such marker (e.g. found by label or as a configured legacy root).

leaves.description: De-duplicated union of open execution leaves across every enumerated root, ordered by compareUnionLeaves: autopilot suitability descending (scored before unscored at the same effective score), then an optional discover.milestoneScope match, then effort ascending (S before M before L), then issue number ascending.

number.description: Issue number of this execution leaf.

state.description: Open/closed state of this execution leaf.

labels.description: Labels currently applied to this execution leaf.

classification.description: Always execution; only nodes in a root's execution-candidate set become union leaves.

roadmapMarkerId.description: This leaf's own embedded roadmap-id marker, normally empty since that marker denotes a roadmap node rather than an execution leaf.

autopilotSuitability.description: Authored autopilot-suitability score (1-5) or null when unscored. The `enum` enumerates every coherent value, so the full null | 1..5 contract (including the upper bound and rejection of non-numeric values) is enforced here, matching parseAutopilotSuitability at runtime.

effort.description: Authored effort hint (S | M | L) or null when no coherent marker is present. A soft A4 Step 2 selection tie-breaker only (after suitability/desync, before lowest issue number); fail-safe on absence, matching parseEffort at runtime.

milestone.description: Title of this leaf's OPEN milestone (string) when it has one and it is open, or null when it has none, the milestone is closed, or the field was absent from the API response -- every null case is the same neutral input for the discover.milestoneScope A4 Step 2 preference (#2340).

sourceRoots.description: Every open roadmap root number this leaf is reachable from, sorted ascending; a leaf shared by sibling roots carries every source root here but is listed once in leaves.

activeClaim.description: Active-claim annotation, present only under --with-claim-state, where it is always an object (Design O): present:false (with claimId:null, agentId:null) means no trusted claim is present, present:true means one exists (possibly stale). The object is constrained by `type: object` + `required` + `properties` + `additionalProperties: false`; the runtime contract is { present, stale, claimId, agentId, heartbeatOverdue, ownedByCurrentSession? }. ownedByCurrentSession is intentionally absent from `required`: it is emitted only with --current-claim-id. heartbeatOverdue (#1433) is a purely diagnostic sibling to stale (true when the latest valid claimed-by/heartbeat created_at is at or past the configured claimTiming.heartbeatInterval, with no later trusted heartbeat; false otherwise, including whenever present is false) and never feeds claimEligible or any other gate.

present.description: True when a trusted claim marker exists for this leaf, whether or not it is stale -- see stale below for takeover eligibility.

stale.description: True when the present claim's evidence is older than the configured claim stale-age threshold.

claimId.description: Active claim id (string) when present:true, or null when present:false. The in-repo validator cannot express the `string | null` union, so no `type` is declared here; the runtime contract is string | null.

agentId.description: Active claim agent id (string) when present:true, or null when present:false. The in-repo validator cannot express the `string | null` union, so no `type` is declared here; the runtime contract is string | null.

heartbeatOverdue.description: Purely diagnostic (#1433): never gates claimEligible. See the activeClaim description above for the derivation.

ownedByCurrentSession.description: Present only when --current-claim-id is supplied: true when the active claim's claimId equals it.

claimEligible.description: Derived eligibility, present only under --with-claim-state: true when no present, non-stale, trusted-actor claim blocks this leaf.

diagnostics.description: De-duplicated problem-reference buckets accumulated across every per-root enumeration; a reference shared by sibling roots is reported once.

duplicateReferences.description: Same-shaped reference edges seen more than once from the same source issue.

source.description: Issue number of the referencing issue.

target.description: Issue number of the referenced issue.

relationship.description: Reference kind, e.g. task-list, sub-issue, dependency, or reference.

evidence.description: Raw source-body line the reference was extracted from.

firstSeenFrom.description: Source issue number of the first occurrence of this same reference, for tracing which mention is the duplicate.

cycles.description: Traversal back-edges where a reference's target is already an ancestor in the current enumeration path.

source.description: Issue number of the referencing issue that closed the cycle.

target.description: Issue number of the ancestor issue the cycle closes back to.

relationship.description: Reference kind of the edge that closed the cycle.

path.description: Full traversal path from the enumeration root through to the repeated target.

inaccessibleReferences.description: References whose target issue lookup failed as forbidden, gone, or otherwise inaccessible.

source.description: Issue number of the referencing issue.

target.description: Issue number of the inaccessible referenced issue.

evidence.description: Raw source-body line the reference was extracted from.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure token for why this reference could not be read.

unresolvedReferences.description: References whose target could not be resolved to an existing issue at all.

source.description: Issue number of the referencing issue.

target.description: Issue number of the unresolved referenced issue.

evidence.description: Raw source-body line the reference was extracted from.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure token for why this reference could not be resolved.

summary.description: Aggregate counts over the union roots, leaves, and diagnostics above.

scoredLeafCount.description: Count of leaves carrying a coherent autopilot-suitability score.

sharedLeafCount.description: Count of leaves reachable from more than one source root.

startableCount.description: Count of union leaves with readiness.startable === true; present only under --with-readiness, absent otherwise so the flag-absent output stays byte-stable.

readyCount.description: Count of union leaves with readiness.ready === true; present only under --with-readiness, absent otherwise.

duplicateReferenceCount.description: Count of de-duplicated entries in diagnostics.duplicateReferences.

cycleCount.description: Count of de-duplicated entries in diagnostics.cycles.

inaccessibleReferenceCount.description: Count of de-duplicated entries in diagnostics.inaccessibleReferences.

unresolvedReferenceCount.description: Count of de-duplicated entries in diagnostics.unresolvedReferences.
